questions.ask: You say "41 of the 60 are still paying" after about two months. That means 19 of 60 families quit. Have you talked to every one of those 19? What exactly did they tell you, and what did you ship that week because of it?

You want money "to hire one engineer and add two more grocery stores", but you have two founders, and one of them built a meal planner. Why can't the two of you add those stores and fix churn yourselves first? What is the next thing you'll ship this week, before any new hire?
questions.quote: to hire one engineer and add two more grocery stores
